biography.plain_text: Angelo Goffi is an Italian food entrepreneur from Bergamo and the founder of Italcanditi. He inherited his father Alfredo’s confectionery workshop and expanded it into an industrial business serving international markets from Pedrengo. After decades of family ownership, the Goffis sold a majority stake to Investindustrial while retaining a minority interest.

long_biography.plain_text:
The growing popularity of packaged snack cakes led Angelo Goffi to broaden Italcanditi’s range of ingredients. He developed jams, candied fruit and water-based creams for manufacturers responding to demand for convenient breakfasts. The company established a research department to customise products for customers, then extended its work to fruit preparations for yoghurt.

Goffi’s memoir, published in 2019, set the business alongside recollections of his post-war childhood, military service and married life. Prepared with Annalisa De Bernardin, it asks whether entrepreneurs are born or made. His account also includes the motor races he entered.
